metadata.question: Were there two isolated islands within a 2 km radius of (27.245974, 140.878144) on March 30, 2014?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Point at (27.245974, 140.878144) - this is in the Pacific Ocean east of Japan - Date: March 30, 2014 - Need to check if there were two isolated islands within 2 km radius - Will use Sentinel-2 or Landsat for visual/classification data. However, Sentinel-2 started in June 2015, so I'll use Landsat 8 (which started Feb 2013) or Landsat 7 - Create a 2 km buffer around the point and check for land/water classification 2. Masking strategy: - Need to identify land vs. water pixels - Can use NDVI or water masks, or use a land/water classification dataset - Will look for pixel clusters that represent islands (high NDVI or specific band combinations) 3. Logic to distinguish: - C1: No images found for the date/location - C2: Images exist but no valid land pixels (all water or cloud-covered) - C3: Calculation returns invalid result - A: Yes, two isolated islands detected - B: No, fewer or more than two islands, or islands not isolated ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Define geometry and time const lon = 140.878144; const lat = 27.245974; const point = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]); const bufferDist = 2000; // 2 km in meters const searchRadius = ee.Geometry.Point([lon, lat]).buffer(bufferDist); const startDate = '2014-03-25'; const endDate = '2014-04-04'; // 2. Acquire Landsat 8 imagery (started Feb 2013) let col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(searchRadius) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); let size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Landsat 8 Images (Mar 2014): ${size}`); // Fallback to Landsat 7 if no L8 data if (size === 0) { col = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(searchRadius) .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 50)); size = col.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Fallback to Landsat 7 Images: ${size}`); } if (size === 0) { console.log('No data found for location/date.'); console.log('C1'); return; } // 3. Select first available image const img = col.first(); // 4. Calculate NDVI to identify land const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['SR_B5', 'SR_B4']); // 5. Create land mask (NDVI > 0.3 typically indicates vegetation/land) const landMask = ndvi.gt(0.2); // 6. Count land pixels in the 2km buffer const landPixelCount = landMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: searchRadius, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('nd').getInfo(); console.log(`Valid land pixels in 2km radius: ${landPixelCount}`); if (landPixelCount === null || landPixelCount === 0) { console.log('No valid land pixels detected.'); console.log('C2'); return; } // 7. Use connected components to identify isolated island clusters const landPixels = landMask.updateMask(landMask); const connected = landPixels.connectedComponents(ee.Kernel.plus(1), 256); // 8. Count unique clusters (islands) const clusterCount = connected.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.countDistinct(), geometry: searchRadius, scale: 30, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('labels').getInfo(); console.log(`Island clusters detected: ${clusterCount}`); if (clusterCount === null) { console.log('Cluster calculation failed.'); console.log('C3'); return; } // 9. Final answer if (clusterCount === 2) { console.log('Two isolated islands confirmed within 2km radius.'); console.log('A'); } else { console.log(`Found ${clusterCount} clusters, not exactly 2 islands.`); console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
